name: cohere
description: Command chat, Embed, Rerank, Parse and Transcribe models on Cohere's platform API
long_description: Bring a Cohere API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists one model (GET /v1/models?page_size=1), which runs no model. A Sprite can then list and read models, chat with Command models, create embeddings, rerank documents, tokenize and detokenize text, parse document images and transcribe audio. Chat, embed, rerank and parse requests are billed to a production key, and transcription is free but rate-limited; on a trial key every call counts against its limits. Datasets, embed jobs, batches, fine-tuning, connectors, the v1 chat, embed, rerank, generate, summarize and classify endpoints, and Model Vault are not forwarded.

examples.title: Transcribe audio (multipart upload; free on Cohere's API, rate-limited)
notes: Send multipart form fields `model` (`cohere-transcribe-03-2026`), `language` (ISO-639-1, such as `en`) and `file`, for example with `curl -F model=cohere-transcribe-03-2026 -F language=en -F file=@recording.mp3`. Cohere accepts files up to 25 MB, but the gateway accepts request bodies of at most 8,000,000 bytes (8 MB).

messages.400: Cohere rejected the request (%{status}); see the body's message
messages.403: Cohere key lacks permission for this request (%{status}); check the key and model access
messages.404: Cohere model or route not found; check GET /v1/models
messages.422: Cohere could not process the request parameters; see the body's message
messages.429: Cohere rate limit or trial key limit reached; wait and retry, or use a production key
messages.498: Cohere refused a deny-listed token in the request or response
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Cohere; retry later

presentation.tagline: Chat, embed and rerank with Cohere from a Sprite without putting your API key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at dashboard.cohere.com, open API Keys and create a trial or production key. Trial keys are free but rate-limited and capped at 1,000 calls a month.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key calls `GET /v1/models?page_size=1`, which runs no model and is not priced; on a trial key it may count toward the 1,000 calls a month. With a production key, chat is billed per input and output token, embed per embedded token, rerank per search and parse per page parsed. Cohere's Transcribe page says transcription on the API is free but rate-limited, with production use through Model Vault. Model listing, tokenize and detokenize run no model. Chat responses report what was billed in `usage.billed_units`; embed, rerank and parse responses in `meta.billed_units`.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/:model`, `POST /v2/chat`, `POST /v2/embed`, `POST /v2/rerank`, `POST /v1/tokenize`, `POST /v1/detokenize`, `POST /v2/parse` and `POST /v2/audio/transcriptions` are forwarded, all on api.cohere.com. Datasets, embed jobs, batches, fine-tuning, connectors, the `check-api-key` endpoint, the v1 chat, embed, rerank, generate, summarize and classify endpoints, Model Vault and cloud-marketplace deployments are not.

notices.title: Trial keys
notices.body: Trial keys allow 20 chat requests a minute per model, 10 rerank requests a minute, 2,000 embedded inputs a minute and 5 transcriptions a minute, and 1,000 calls a month in total. Newer models such as Command A+ keep trial limits on production keys unless Cohere sales raises them.

usage_notes: The gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers. Cohere's chat API has no timeout parameter, so use `stream: true` and a `max_tokens` cap for long or reasoning generations.
Error bodies are `{"id": "...", "message": "..."}`. A wrong key is 401; Cohere also documents 498 for deny-listed tokens and 499 when a request is cancelled.
